metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the C++20 RS274/G-code simulator in:

- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp)

Supports CLI execution, modal state, motion, arcs, canned cycles, coordinate systems, parameters, tool tables, probing, block delete, and trace output.

Build verified with:

```bash
cmake -B build /workspace/output
cmake --build build
```

Executable: `/workspace/build/simulator`
